descriptionChirho: Qal: to go out to meet someone, to encounter purposefully, used with preposition lamed + infinitive construct indicating deliberate movement toward a person
Qal: of events, calamities, or circumstances befalling or happening to a person, often with negative connotation of misfortune or divine judgment overtaking someone
Hifil: causative sense, to bring something upon someone, to cause calamity or circumstance to meet/overtake a person
Nifal infinitive absolute used adverbially to express chance or accident, indicating something occurring without deliberate cause or design
Nifal: reciprocal or middle-voice meeting, where two parties encounter each other, often implying mutual or unexpected encounter
Nifal imperfect passive sense: to be met with, to be found or encountered in a location or situation
Nifal of the homographic root qara (to call): to be called or named, likely a different lexical root (H7121) tagged under this lemma
